title: Pre-Editorial Normalization for Automatically Transcribed Medieval Manuscripts in Old French and Latin
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical linguistic task of normalizing medieval text transcriptions (Old French and Latin). While many of the manuscripts used in the corpus are religious in nature (missals, sermons, canon law), the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, ethics, or moral values; it only benchmarks the performance of transcription models using character and word error rates.
